Import CSV into a new list

Drop a CSV file here One row per purchase works best (a deed, sales or permit export). One row per buyer with a property count also works. Florida tax roll files (the county NAL file, or the statewide parcel table built from it) are read automatically.
●Florida tax roll file. Each owner becomes a buyer, with their most recent sale as the purchase. Vacant parcels count as lots, and homes built the year of the sale or after count as new builds. Owners who mostly buy lots are marked as builders, and people living in the home they bought are left out.
Match your columns

Location: rows with latitude and longitude are mapped exactly. Rows with only a ZIP are placed at the ZIP's center. The page can't look up street addresses, so add a ZIP or coordinates to each row. Business or person and buyer type are guessed from the name when you don't have those columns.
